title: Why Costco built its own chicken farms #shorts
summary: Costco's rotisserie chicken has cost $4.99 since 2009, and Costco built its own chicken operation to keep it there.
sources: Rotisserie chicken $4.99 and Costco's Nebraska poultry operation (Fortune, citing NPR): https://fortune.com/2018/10/24/costco-kirkland-rotisserie-chickens-supply-chain

scenes.narration: Costco built a whole chicken operation to protect one price: {$4.99.|four ninety-nine.}
The Nebraska plant was built to produce over two million chickens a week.
That's not a grocery store move. That's a promise.
Members don't pay for chicken. They pay for promises like this one.
